name: phone-grounded
description: Found-footage realism — looks like an ordinary phone captured one impossible thing. The anti-spectacle look for 'unreal' reels.

style_bible.visual_style: ordinary smartphone footage, handheld, naturalistic, not a film production
style_bible.lighting_style: flat overcast or fluorescent, boring/available light, no dramatic lighting

negative: No text, no captions, no split screen, no panels. No cinematic grading, no golden hour, no studio lighting, no rim light.
grounding_rules: One impossible thing per shot; everything else physically ordinary.
Anchor to a real, mundane, specific place; let the impossible intrude.
Phone-camera realism: slight overexposure, autofocus settling, mild compression; lightly stabilized, not wildly shaky.
Default all-in-focus; shallow depth only when a phone would synthesize it.
People react like bystanders who grabbed a phone, not film extras.
notes: This is ONE preset, not the law. Don't apply phone-grounding to cinematic projects.
